facts.fact: Somalia's National Communications Authority invited public comments on its draft 2023-2027 strategic plan, with the draft offered for download on its website and comments by email to consultation@nca.gov.so until 20 July 2023.

note: The law requires public consultation by the agency but the passages do not say it is online.
A consultation meeting with operators; written comments invited, but no online channel or online posting is stated.

facts.fact: On 17 March 2024 Lower House Speaker Madobe launched a Digital Platform for Public Consultations, built by the Independent Constitutional Review and Implementation Commission, to gather citizens' feedback on the proposed constitutional amendments, per Radio Dalsan.
